degree_rationale: Three plagues and three wars caused by the light's conflict with darkness: the binding in the Living Soul, the Great Fire's separation, the final male-female cleaving. Mechanism of cosmic plague and recovery.
direction_rationale: Closes the spiritual-east arc with the foundational threefold strike-mechanism upon the darkness. Originating sequence of judicial plagues.
grand_man_function: Spiritual plague-mechanism — the engine of cosmic strikes upon the Enemy.
title: Three plagues and three wars caused by the light's conflict with darkness
